title: Groww Fee Explainer

sample_context.candidate_note: Fee-related phrases are keyword candidates, not confirmed complaints.

explanation_bullets.text: Equity brokerage is shown as Rs 20 or 0.1% per executed order, whichever is lower, with a minimum of Rs 5.
DP charges are shown for sell transactions, including depository and Groww components, with a Rs 0 Groww component for sale value below Rs 100 debit value.
Regulatory and statutory charges include STT, stamp duty, exchange transaction charge, SEBI turnover charge, DP charges, IPFT charge, and related charges.

GST of 18% applies on brokerage, DP charges, exchange transaction charges, IPFT, SEBI turnover charges, delayed payment charges, DDPI charges, KYC modification request charges, API charges, and auto square-off charges.
Auto square-off charges are listed at Rs 50 per position for open intraday positions squared off by the system.
Other charges listed include delayed payment charges of 0.05% per day, Pledge/Unpledge charges of Rs 20 per ISIN, and UPI mandate balance equity brokerage of 1% of order value with no maximum cap.

limitations: Only official Groww website and help-center documentation is used for factual fee explanations.
Customer-reported confusion provides context only and is not treated as verified evidence.
Fee schedules, order types, taxes, and regulatory charges can change; confirm current charges on Groww's official pages before making customer-facing statements.
Pricing may change; this records the page as accessed on 2026-10-14 and should be rechecked before making fee claims to customers.
The page is specific to intraday charges and should not be treated as a complete description of all Groww charges.
The page gives a summary and directs users to the pricing section for a detailed breakdown.
customer_context: Fee-related phrases appeared in 206 of the 300 sampled reviews. These keyword matches indicate possible fee confusion but are not confirmed complaints.
